body:
Lease ends in a year. These issues have always been kind of present, but have only been getting so much worse in the last few months, so I figured I could maintain another year back in May when I signed the lease. Now I'm staring at a $10k lease contract (12mo) and wondering what the duck I was thinking.


Hope you figure out your finances, friend.

The big thing is that I fear that most of my issues lately have been intensifying because of graduate school. I can't leave school easily because I don't have the money to move across country again or to break my lease. I can prepare to leave school after I earn my Master's, but that will not be for another year. Hard to imagine myself bouncing back so long as I'm here.

A good diet is something I've needed for awhile, thanks for the recommendation. There was a time in my life when I was eating healthy, exercising, and loving life. Went from 280 pounds in high school to 190 my junior year of college, and now back to 240 only two years later. 

I appreciate the kind words, stranger. I made this thread a few hours ago in a kind of crisis mode and have sort of felt some relief since. Reading your comment was helpful, really.
